question: What additional metal objects taken improperly are included in the expiation list?
premises: Improper taking of objects requires expiation.
Brass and other bell-metal items are specified.
Metal objects in general are also included.
inference: Therefore, taking brass, other bell-metal items, and metal objects is included among acts requiring expiation.
plain_english: It also includes taking brass and other bell-metal items, and other metal objects.
